bias_targets.methodology: Regressing the predicted physician fatigue score (derived from natural language features of clinical notes) against patient self-reported race and ethnicity (Black, Hispanic, White), controlling for physician fixed effects, time, and chief complaints.
Regressing the predicted physician fatigue score against the patient's gender (Female vs. Male) to measure disparities in how notes are written.
Regressing the predicted physician fatigue score against the patient's age to evaluate if older or younger patients systematically receive notes exhibiting different fatigue levels.

Comparing the predicted fatigue scores in notes written for Hispanic patients based on their self-reported primary language (English vs. Spanish) to check if the racial bias effect is confounded by language differences.
